patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column layout for feature blocks, alternating the position of a large, colorful geometric shape with a text description.
Elegant serif typeface for prominent headings, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text, creating a sophisticated yet readable hierarchy.
A high-contrast dark mode palette featuring a deep charcoal background, crisp white text, and vibrant, saturated accent colors for interactive elements and abstract graphics.
Sections animate into view with a subtle upward slide and fade effect as the user scrolls, revealing content progressively.
Feature sections are visually anchored by large, abstract geometric shapes rendered in bright, contrasting colors, which serve as visual metaphors for the section's content.

technique_notes: The overall aesthetic is achieved through a dark background with high-contrast light typography and vibrant, isolated splashes of color.
Content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls, employing a gentle upward translation and opacity transition to introduce new information.
The site's logo maintains a fixed position at the top of the viewport, ensuring continuous brand presence.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body size) with generous line height, paired with a clean, readable sans-serif body text.

standout: The use of bold, abstract geometric shapes with vibrant colors as visual anchors for each feature section, set against a stark dark background, creates a distinctive and artistic feel that elevates the content beyond a typical feature list.
